coverage_notes: Exhaustive survey across 9 major BI platforms (Metabase, Apache Superset, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Grafana, Redash, QuickSight, OBIEE) sweeping: official homepages, pricing pages, technical documentation (API, changelog, release notes), GitHub repositories (for open-source), review aggregators (G2, Capterra, TrustRadius), analyst reports (Gartner Magic Quadrant 2025, Gartner Critical Capabilities, Forrester Wave Q2 2025), funding data (Crunchbase), and feature comparison articles. Deduplication applied across review platforms and analyst mentions. Tiering follows rubric: T0 = primary sources (official sites, pricing, funding records); T1 = official product docs/API/changelogs; T2 = analyst reports + review aggregates; T3 = third-party guides/comparisons/blogs. Coverage captures 70+ unique sources across all product categories. Notable: G2/Capterra consolidation (2026-02-05) noted; Forrester Wave and Gartner reports recent (Q2 2025); multiple 2026 release updates captured. Gaps minimal: granular security/compliance docs not exhaustively captured for all products; some vendor proprietary analyst reports behind paywalls.
